# test with imported and not used
! bolero test github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/vendor/mylibtesttest/myapp/myapp_test.go
stderr 'imported and not used'

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/./vendor_test.go --
package main

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/clsung/fake"
)

func TestVendor(t *testing.T) {
	ret := fake.DoNothing()
	expected := "Ok"
	if expected != ret {
		t.Errorf("fake returned %q, expected %q", ret, expected)
	}
}

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/./vendor/mylibtesttest/myapp/myapp_test.go --
package myapp
import (
   "mylibtesttest/rds"
)

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/./vendor/mylibtesttest/rds/rds.go --
package rds

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/./vendor/github.com/clsung/fake/fake.go --
package fake

func DoNothing() string {
	return "Ok"
}

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/github.com/clsung/go-vendor-issue-14613/./m.go --
package main

func main() {}
